theme_central: A ring structure: the preserved Book frames the surah (opening and closing), with the cosmological and historical proofs of its truth at the centre.
sources_note: Ring structure of 3 sections + closing, well documented (thequran.love / surah.pk): 1-15, 16-44, 45-84; closing 85-99 reconstructed from known landmarks (the final verse "worship until certainty comes to you," 15:99).

branches.title: The Book facing the mockers
branches.resume: Future regret of the disbelievers, every city has a fixed term, mockery toward the Prophet.

children.t: Future regret of the disbelievers for not having submitted
Every city has a fixed and written term
Mockery of the disbelievers; even an open door to heaven would not convince them

branches.title: Creation, Iblis
branches.resume: The heavens and the earth created with precise measure, the creation of Adam, Iblis's refusal and the respite granted to him.

children.t: The heavens, the constellations, the earth spread out, everything created with measure
Creation of Adam, Iblis's refusal to bow down, the respite granted to him
Description of Hell with seven gates

branches.title: Historical lessons
branches.resume: The Paradise of the pious, then the accounts of Ibrahim, Lot, the people of the Wood and of al-Hijr (Thamud).

children.t: Description of the Paradise promised to the pious
Ibrahim's guests announce Ishaq and the imminent destruction of the people of Lot
Destruction of the people of Lot, a sign for those who reflect
The people of the Wood and the people of al-Hijr (Thamud), rejecting the signs

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Patience and forgiveness, proclaiming the message openly, worshipping Allah until certainty.

children.t: Patience, gracious forgiveness, not envying what the disbelievers have
Warning against those who divided the Qur'an into fragments
Proclaiming the message openly; "worship until certainty comes to you"
